name: MasterAI RankWriter
author: masterai

sections.description:
MasterAI RankWriter is a professional-grade WordPress automation tool that transforms your content creation workflow. By leveraging Artificial Intelligence, it handles everything from keyword-based generation to content optimization and distribution.

Key Features:
* AI Content Generation: High-quality, long-form articles powered by Google Gemini with customizable tone, word count, and formatting.
* Automated Images: Intelligent featured image sourcing via Freepik API.
* Keyword Based Automation: Schedule-based article generation directly from your target keywords with flexible scheduling (daily, weekly, monthly, or custom intervals).
* Powerful Scheduler: Set your preferred schedule frequency (Every Day, Every Week, Every Month, or Custom Interval in minutes), choose specific times, configure timezone, and control how many articles to generate per run. Generate articles immediately or let the scheduler handle everything automatically.
* AI Auto-ALT Text: Automatically generate SEO-friendly ALT text, titles, and captions for images using Gemini Vision API.
* Content Gap Analyzer: AI-powered competitor analysis to identify missing content opportunities and boost your rankings.

External Services

This plugin integrates with the following third-party services to provide AI and automation capabilities:

  1. Google Gemini API
    • Service: Artificial Intelligence for content generation and image analysis.
    • Endpoint: generativelanguage.googleapis.com
    • Usage: Sends prompts, settings, and optional image metadata to generate article content and image SEO data when you generate content or analyze images.
    • API Key Signup: makersuite.google.com
    • Terms: Google API Terms
    • Privacy: Google Privacy Policy
  2. Freepik API
    • Service: Stock image provider.
    • Endpoint: api.freepik.com
    • Usage: Sends search keywords to retrieve a relevant featured image when image sourcing is enabled.
    • Terms: Freepik Terms of Service
    • Privacy: Freepik Privacy Policy
  3. Ayrshare API
    • Service: Social media posting.
    • Endpoint: api.ayrshare.com
    • Usage: Sends post text, target platforms, and links when social auto-posting is enabled.
    • Terms: Ayrshare Terms
    • Privacy: Ayrshare Privacy Policy
  4. OneSignal API
    • Service: Push notifications.
    • Endpoint: onesignal.com
    • Usage: Sends notification content (title, excerpt, image, link) when push notifications are enabled.
    • Terms: OneSignal Terms
    • Privacy: OneSignal Privacy Policy
  5. Webpushr API
    • Service: Push notifications.
    • Endpoint: api.webpushr.com
    • Usage: Sends notification content (title, message, image, link) when Webpushr notifications are enabled.
    • Terms: Webpushr Terms
    • Privacy: Webpushr Privacy Policy
  6. Telegram Bot API
    • Service: Telegram channel/chat posting.
    • Endpoint: api.telegram.org
    • Usage: Sends post title and link to your configured chat when Telegram posting is enabled.
    • Terms: Telegram Terms of Service
    • Privacy: Telegram Privacy Policy
  7. Discord Webhooks
    • Service: Discord channel posting.
    • Endpoint: discord.com
    • Usage: Sends post title and link to your configured Discord webhook when Discord posting is enabled.
    • Terms: Discord Terms
    • Privacy: Discord Privacy Policy
  8. YouTube
    • Service: Video search and embeds.
    • Endpoint: www.youtube.com
    • Usage: Sends a search query to find a relevant video when YouTube embedding is enabled, and embeds the selected video in the generated content.
    • Terms: YouTube Terms
    • Privacy: Google Privacy Policy
  9. Google News (RSS)
    • Service: Google News RSS feed.
    • Endpoint: news.google.com
    • Usage: Sends a keyword to fetch trending headlines used to help generate topic ideas.
    • Terms: Google Terms
    • Privacy: Google Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the masterai-rankwriter folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the ‘RankWriter’ menu to configure your settings.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes! The core features are completely free, including AI content generation, keyword-based automation, Freepik image integration, AI Auto-ALT text, Content Gap Analyzer, AI Internal Linking, and Content Refresher. Premium features like Title to Article automation, Social Auto-posting, and Push Notifications require a Pro license.

Where can I get the Pro version?

You can purchase MasterAI RankWriter Pro here: Gumroad Pro Link

Do I need my own API keys?

Yes, you will need to provide your own Google Gemini API key (required for content generation). The Freepik API key is optional but recommended for automatic featured images. Pro features may require additional API keys (Ayrshare, OneSignal, Webpushr, Telegram, Discord).

What AI model does the plugin use?

MasterAI RankWriter uses Google Gemini API for content generation and Gemini Vision API for image analysis and SEO metadata generation.

Can I customize the generated content?

Yes! You can customize word count (1000-3000 words), article tone (neutral, friendly, professional, persuasive, technical), and formatting options (tables, lists, FAQ sections).
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Official rebranding to MasterAI RankWriter.
  • New Feature: AI Auto-ALT Text – Automatically generate SEO-friendly ALT text, titles, and captions for images using Gemini Vision API.
  • New Feature: Content Gap Analyzer – AI-powered competitor analysis to identify missing content opportunities.
  • Enhancement: Flexible scheduling options – Daily, weekly, monthly, or custom interval scheduling.
  • Enhancement: Customizable article tone with auto-detection option.
  • Enhancement: Advanced formatting options including tables, lists, and FAQ sections.
  • Comprehensive security audit and output escaping for WordPress.org compliance.
  • Introduced “Upgrade to Pro” section to highlight premium automation features.
  • Refined interactive dashboard with smooth accordion transitions and feature navigation.
  • Removed internal telemetry tracking for improved privacy.
  • Added support for multiple push notification and social services (OneSignal, Webpushr, Telegram, Discord, Ayrshare).
